name: Chinese
description: The traditional Chinese star system: Three Enclosures around the pole, the Twenty-Eight Mansions along the ecliptic grouped into the Four Symbols, and the xingguan asterisms of the Yixiang kaocheng.
source: Stellarium sky culture 'chinese' (index.json, description.md): https://github.com/Stellarium/stellarium/tree/master/skycultures/chinese - Karrie Berglund (Digitalis Education Solutions) from Hong Kong Space Museum maps; Sun Shuwei (200+ xingguan, 3000+ stars) after Yi Shitong, Chinese and Western Contrast Star Chart and Catalogue 1950.0, and Yixiang kaocheng (1756) / Xubian (1844).
HYG Star Database v4.1 (astronexus/HYG-Database, hyg/CURRENT/hygdata_v41.csv) for stars not already in constellations.json: https://github.com/astronexus/HYG-Database

figures.name: Purple Forbidden Enclosure
